spans.s: वेतं(दं)ड m. An elephant.

वेद m. 1. Knolwledge; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. a bundle of kuśa grass, M.iv.36; 4. name of the scriptures of the Hindus; (they were originally three, viz., ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद and सामवेद; to these the अथर्ववेद seems to have been subsequently added).[These writings are regarded as a direct revelation from the Deity and are called Śruti (what is heard) to distinguish them from Smṛti or sacred lore of human origin; the several sages to whom verse or hymns of the Vedas are ascribed are regarded as seers (द्रष्टारः) and not as composers (स्रष्टारः).]

वेद-अंग n. name of certain works which are regarded as auxiliary to the Vedas; [these are divided into six branchs, each branch being probably represented at one time by several works; they are- (1) शिक्षा ‘the science of pronunciation,’ (2) छंदस् ‘prosody,’ (3) व्याकरण ‘grammar,’ (4) निरुक्त ‘philological explanation of difficult Vedic words,’ (5) ज्योतिष ‘astronomy,’ (6) कल्प ‘ceremonial’].
वेद-अधिगम m. the study of the Vedas.
वेद-अध्यापक m. a teacher of the Vedas.

वेद-अंत m. 1. an Upanishad; 2. the last and perhaps the latest of the six systems of philosophy (so called as being principally based on the Upanishads); it is also called उत्तरमीमांसा, being regarded as a sequel to the Mīmānsā system of Jaimini; it represents the popular pantheistic creed of India.
वेद-अंत˚ग, ˚ज्ञ m. a follower of the Vedānta philosophy.
वेद-अंत˚ग, ˚ज्ञ m. a follower of the Vedānta philosophy.
वेद-अंतिन् m. a follower of the Vedānta philosophy.
वेद-अर्थ m. the meaning of the Vedas.
वेद-अवतार m. revelation of the Vedas.
वेद-आदि न्।, -आदिवर्ण म्।, -आदिबीज न्। n. the sacred syllable Om.
वेद-आदिवर्ण m. the sacred syllable Om.
वेद-आदि न्।, -आदिवर्ण म्।, -आदिबीज न्। n. the sacred syllable Om.
वेद-उक्त a. scriptural.
वेद-कौलेयक m. an epithet of Śiva.
वेद-गर्भ m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. a Brāhmaṇa learned in the Vedas.
वेद-ज्ञ m. a Brāhmaṇa versed in the Vedas.
वेद-त्रय n. the three Vedas, (ऋग्यजुःसामानि).
वेद-त्रयी f. the three Vedas, (ऋग्यजुःसामानि).
वेद-निंदक m. an atheist, an unbeliever.
वेद-निंदा f. unbelief, heresy.
वेद-पारग m. a Brāhmaṇa skilled in the Vedas.
वेद-मातृ f. a particular Ṛch called Gāyatrī q.v.
वेद-वचन n. a Vedic text.
वेद-वदन n. grammar.
वेद-वास m. a Brāhmaṇa.
वेद-विद् m. a Brāhmaṇa conversant with the Vedas.
वेद-विहित a. enjoined by the Vedas.
वेद-व्यास m. an epithet of Vyāsa as being the arranger of the Vedas, वेदव्यासः स नव दश यो वेद वेदाक्षराणि Venkaṭādhvari.
वेद-संन्यास m. discontinuance of the ritual of the Vedas.

वेदन n. 1. Knowledge, perception; 2. acquisition, wealth, property; 3. marrying, marriage, M.iii.44; 4. sensation, experiencing.(वेदना is used also in the sense of ‘pain, agony, torment,’ सहतां हतजीवितं मम प्रबलामात्मकृतेन वेदनाम् R.viii.50.)

वेदना f. 1. Knowledge, perception; 2. acquisition, wealth, property; 3. marrying, marriage, M.iii.44; 4. sensation, experiencing.(वेदना is used also in the sense of ‘pain, agony, torment,’ सहतां हतजीवितं मम प्रबलामात्मकृतेन वेदनाम् R.viii.50.)
वेदार m. A lizard.
वेदि (I) m. A learned man, a paṇḍit.

वेदि (II) f. 1. An altar, one prepared for a sacrifice; 2. a quadrangular spot before a temple or a palace; 3. a seal-ring, मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या K.S.i.39 (against Mall. who renders वेदि by परिष्कृता भूमिः); 4. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
वेदी f. The same as वेदि II q.v.
वेदि-जा f. an epithet of Draupadī who was born from the midst of an altar.
वेदिका f. 1. A raised spot of ground prepared for auspicious purposes, K.S.iii.44; 2. an open shade in the middle of a courtyard; 3. a bower, an arbour.
वेदिन् m. 1. A teacher; 2. a learned Brāhmaṇa; 3. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
वेद्य a. (f. द्या) 1. To be known; 2. to be taught; 3. to be married.
वेद्य a. (f. द्या) 1. To be known; 2. to be taught; 3. to be married.
